screening_decisions.reason: Randomised, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled crossover trial evaluating a systemic oral immunomodulator in alopecia totalis (a severe form of AA). Meets RCT and intervention criteria.
Randomised, placebo‑controlled trial of a systemic corticosteroid (oral prednisolone) in extensive alopecia areata. Fits RCT and systemic intervention criteria.
Randomised, investigator‑blinded controlled trial comparing two topical corticosteroid formulations for mild‑to‑moderate AA. Meets RCT and topical intervention criteria.
Double‑blind, placebo‑controlled RCT of topical 3% minoxidil in extensive AA, AT and AU. Satisfies both RCT and topical intervention requirements.
Randomised, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled trial of topical minoxidil (with a crossover design). Clearly an RCT evaluating a topical treatment for extensive AA/AT/AU.
Randomised, double‑blind intra‑patient design comparing DPCP alone versus DPCP + topical minoxidil. RCT of topical agents for chronic severe AA.
Randomly assigned patients to three different treatment arms (topical cyclosporine, PUVA, intravenous thymopentin). Includes both topical and systemic interventions and is a randomized trial.
Small (n=6) uncontrolled study; lacks clear randomisation and placebo control, so does not meet the RCT requirement.
Randomised, double‑blind trial comparing topical cyclosporin A with vehicle in AA. Satisfies RCT and topical intervention criteria.
Double‑blind, placebo‑controlled RCT of systemic imipramine for AA. Meets both RCT and systemic intervention requirements.
Randomised allocation to three arms (topical, systemic, combination) in a chronic severe AA population. Clear RCT evaluating both topical and systemic modalities.
Double‑blind, randomised trial of topical cyclosporin A versus placebo in AA. Fits RCT and topical criteria.
Randomised, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled trial of a topical clobetasol foam for moderate‑to‑severe AA. Meets RCT and topical criteria.
Randomised controlled trial comparing systemic prednisone taper with or without adjunctive topical minoxidil. Directly evaluates both systemic and topical interventions.
Contains a double‑blind, placebo‑controlled component evaluating topical minoxidil for extensive AA. Satisfies RCT and topical intervention requirements.
Controlled trial (119 patients) comparing several therapies (including topical agents) against placebo. Randomisation is implied; meets RCT criteria for topical interventions.
Observational questionnaire study; no intervention, no randomisation.
Commentary / methodological paper, not a trial evaluating an intervention for AA/AT/AU.
Randomised, double‑blind, controlled trial of topical essential‑oil aromatherapy versus carrier oil placebo in AA. Meets RCT and topical intervention criteria.
Narrative review article; no original trial data.
Population‑based incidence study; observational, no intervention.
Observational analysis of prognostic factors; not a randomised trial of an intervention.
Study design not clearly described as randomised; ambiguous allocation prevents confident inclusion as RCT.
Review article on genetics; no intervention trial.
Methodological article discussing trial quality; not a primary RCT on AA/AT/AU.
